technical_and_design_decisions: Use JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test, and Spring Integration Test frameworks for writing acceptance tests.

Utilize embedded servers and containers (e.g., GreenMail for Mail, Apache SSHD embedded SFTP server, WireMock for HTTP, TCP/UDP sockets for Reactor IP/Syslog) to ensure reliable isolated test execution in CI.
Structure acceptance tests to verify end-to-end data flow into and out of source and processor modules under standard operational scenarios.
Standardize test configuration and helper utility methods across modules to minimize code duplication.
assumptions: Source and processor modules are already fully implemented and stable; the scope is strictly limited to adding acceptance tests.
The target CI environment supports executing embedded servers, sockets, and standard Java test harnesses during the build process.
Existing build tools (Gradle or Maven) are configured and ready for test integration.
Sample data files (e.g., valid PMML models, sample mail messages, syslog messages) can be created and checked into the repository for test fixtures.

activities.activity_name: Test Infrastructure Setup and Base Utilities
activities.activity_description: Set up shared test dependencies, base test classes, common fixtures, and configure test execution task profiles in the build system.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Mail Source Module (U1)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests using GreenMail/embedded mail server to validate receiving and processing emails in the Mail source module.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for reactor-ip Source Module (U2)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests establishing TCP/UDP connections to validate payload ingestion and reactive stream handling in reactor-ip source module.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for reactor-syslog Source Module (U3)
activities.activity_description: Create acceptance tests sending RFC-compliant Syslog messages via TCP/UDP sockets to verify parsing and message emission in reactor-syslog source module.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for SFTP Source Module (U4)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests utilizing an embedded SFTP server to test remote file polling, fetching, and channel message creation in the SFTP source module.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Aggregator Processor Module (U5)
activities.activity_description: Write acceptance tests to validate correlation strategies, release conditions, sequence headers, and timeouts in the aggregator processor module.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Analytic-PMML Processor Module (U6)
activities.activity_description: Construct acceptance tests with sample PMML models to validate model loading, payload evaluation, and prediction output mapping in the analytic-pmml processor module.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for Bridge Processor Module (U7)
activities.activity_description: Develop acceptance tests to ensure input-to-output channel forwarding, header propagation, and message pass-through integrity in the bridge processor module.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for HTTP-Client Processor Module (U8)
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance tests using WireMock to verify HTTP request building, response handling, error handling, and payload transformation in the http-client processor module.
Integrate all newly created acceptance test suites into the automated CI build script, verify successful execution in the pipeline, and finalize documentation.
